description: Which weekday and 2-hour slot the audience of the WHOLE account plays the most (or sees the player the most) in a period — "best time to publish". Weekday × 2-hour slot grid, summed over the period — the same grid as the dashboard heatmap (Analytics → Best times), with the hours exactly as Panda analytics stores them. Returns {start_date, end_date, metric, best_slots: [{weekday, hours, total}] (top 10), by_weekday, by_hours}. For specific videos or a folder use panda_get_best_times_by_videos.

metric.description: 'plays' = unique plays (dashboard default) or 'impressions' = unique player views

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days ago — always sent, since the API returns partial data without it.

name: panda_get_best_times
title: Get Best Times (Account)
